name: KETOCONAZOLE 200 MG 10 TABLETS
description: Ketoconazole 200 mg tablets are a prescription antifungal medication used to treat serious fungal and yeast infections. Its oral use has been restricted by some health agencies due to the risk of severe liver toxicity, and it is only recommended when other therapies are unavailable or not tolerated. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
